newsitem.title: DUBAI: French warships dock in Dubai.
newsitem.headline: French warships dock in Dubai.

text.p: Two French warships docked in Dubai on Thursday in a display of France's support for its defence partner the United Arab Emirates (UAE), French naval sources said.
The helicopter carrier Jeanne d'Arc and the frigate Germinal arrived on a training mission as part of a four-month voyage to the Mediterranean, the Indian Ocean and Southeast Asia.
French naval sources said the visit also aimed to demonstrate France's desire to further develop military cooperation with the oil-rich UAE.
Captain Bruno Sifantus said the purpose of the squadron's stops in Saudi Arabia's Red Sea port of Jeddah, Dubai and later, the Omani capital Muscat was to strengthen ties with regional allies.
The UAE is a major customer for French weapons. It has a defence accord with Paris which has pledged to rush up to 70,000 members of a rapid reaction force to the Gulf if the UAE is threatened.
